The `_python=/usr/bin/python` assignment is safe and avoids environment dependency issues without introducing malicious behavior. All operations that interact with the filesystem or execute programs are confined within package functions, which are not evaluated at this stage.

Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for `--printsrcinfo` poses no risk of unintended code execution or data exfiltration.
</details>
